name: Serizawa Kamo
source:
Hobby: Tobacco

As the head of the Shinsengumi, he is often misunderstood by others for taking offensive jobs, but he actually cares a lot about his friends. His hobby is, surprisingly, Waka.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/baku.html]English official site[/url]]
